name: Cheshire Cat AI
description: Extensible agent framework that starts a ready agent with a web UI and REST API, aimed at learning and research.
whatItDoes: Gives learners, researchers and institutions a running agent they can extend and publish on the web. Version 2 is flagged as unstable alpha and not recommended for production.
howItWorks: Installing the package and running the `ccat` command starts a server with a UI on port 1865 and a REST API playground. The code base is kept small so it can be read and extended.

requirements.name: uv
requirements.description: Used by the quickstart to add and run the package
